nfc.disabled: Turn on NFC to pay by tapping phones.
nfc.permission-denied: Allow NFC to pay by tapping phones.

nearby.disabled: Turn on Bluetooth to pay nearby.
nearby.permission-denied: Pay nearby needs Bluetooth and permission to find nearby devices.

pay.nearby: Pay someone close, no code needed.

receive.qr: The other person scans your code.
receive.nearby: The other person finds you, no code needed.
